marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Something for nothing the all-consuming desire that turns the American dream into a social nightmare

"The United States is the greatest country in the world today - socially, economically, militarily, and by any other measure you can use. America was founded on the basic principles of freedom, equality, self-reliance, personal responsibility and civil society. But now, these bedrock beliefs are facing the greatest threat in history - from within, not without. Today, the rapacious, insatiable desire to get "Something for Nothing" is threatening the very fabric of our personal and social lives." -- from container
